title: PageStyle theme schema
description: Theme data for a single brand: color tokens, typography roles, brand assets, baseFontSize. Compositional content shape (sections, grids, cells) is not part of this schema — that's template-specific. See companion TypeScript definitions at schema/theme-schema.ts.

baseFontSize.description: Base font size in pixels. Default 16. Drives all role-size multipliers via rem-based calc().

HexColor.description: CSS hex color string. 3, 6, or 8 digit form.

SemanticRoleName.description: Closed v2 semantic role vocabulary. See schema/theme-schema.ts for role descriptions and naming conventions (shadcn-aligned: bare names for surfaces, -Foreground suffix for paired text; descriptive names for text-only extensions).

ColorPrimitives.description: Brand-named primitive colors. Keys are brand-chosen identifiers (e.g., 'javvyPurple', 'solsticeBurntOrange', 'ink', 'paper').

SemanticMap.description: Map from semantic role to primitive name. Values must be primitive names declared in ColorPrimitives.

PairingMap.description: Per-primitive pair declarations: which surface text inside renders against when that primitive is used as a background.

GradientPrimitive.description: Gradient role definition. Tint is implicit (consumes brandSubtle role at the declared surface). midStopHex is curation-time output (concrete hex, not a primitive ref). The 25/75 plateau shape is renderer contract.

surface.description: Surface the gradient is intended for. Endpoint color is paper for 'light', brand-dark anchor for 'dark'.

midStopHex.description: Optional pre-computed mid-stop hex (curation-time derivation output). Concrete CSS hex value, NOT a primitive name. Curation rule: srgb-mix(brandSubtle 70%, surface-endpoint). When omitted, renderer falls back to brandSubtle at 100% across the plateau.

midStopHexDark.description: LOCAL EXTENSION (not in canonical schema yet). Dark-surface counterpart to midStopHex: srgb-mix(brandSubtleDark 70%, backgroundDark 30%). Mirrors the role/roleDark pattern.

ColorTokens.description: Complete color token system: primitives + semantic role mappings + pair definitions + gradient definitions.

TextRoleStyle.description: Per-role text styling. Sizes are template-fixed via rem multipliers — NOT in this interface. color is a semantic role reference, NOT a hex value.

MutedRoleStyle.description: Muted role — sparse, only color is overridable.

light.description: URL of logo for light surfaces (dark-foreground asset).

dark.description: URL of logo for dark surfaces (light-foreground asset).

favicon.description: LOCAL EXTENSION (not in canonical schema yet). Favicon asset — URL or data-URL. Surface-agnostic (one per brand). Parallel component-demo PR pending.
